blocks.prompt: 8. The D.C.Os of 11 districts meet to discuss the law-and-order situation in their districts. In how many ways can they be seated at a round table, when two particular D.C.Os insist on sitting together?
blocks.explanation:
11 D.C.Os gol table par bethein ge, lekin do khaas D.C.Os hamesha saath saath bethna chahte hain.
Plan: un dono ko ek 'unit' bana kar baandh dein, units ko gol table par bithayen, phir unit ke andar dono ki jagah badalne ke tareeqe ginein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 11 D.C.Os, round table; do khaas D.C.Os saath bethenge.
Humein find karna hai: bethne ke kul tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Jori ko ek unit maanein: \(11 - 2 + 1 = 10\) units, gol tarteeb \((10 - 1)!\). Jori ke andar \(2!\) tarteebein. Dono ko multiply karein.

Units ginein
\[9 \text{ others} + 1 \text{ pair} = 10 \text{ units}\]
Kyun: Dono ko gond se chipka dena (ek unit bana dena) is baat ki zamanat hai ke woh hamesha saath bethenge. Ab 9 baaqi D.C.Os aur 1 jori, kul 10 cheezein arrange karni hain.

10 units ko gol table par bithayen
\[(10 - 1)! = 9! = 362880\]
Kyun: Yeh 10 units ki gol tarteeb hai (meeting ki table, Case-I). Ek unit fix kar ke baaqi 9 ko 9! tareeqon se.
Dhyan dein: \((11 - 1)!\) lagana ghalat hai; jori ek hi unit hai, is liye units 10 hain, 11 nahi.

Jori ke andar tarteeb
\[2! = 2\]
Kyun: Jori ke do afraad (maan lijiye P aur Q) P-Q ya Q-P ki tarteeb mein beth sakte hain; yeh do alag tarteebein hain. Yeh qadam bhool jana bohat aam ghalti hai.

Multiply karein
\[9! \times 2! = 362880 \times 2 = 725760\]
Kyun: Units ki har tarteeb ke saath jori ki dono tarteebein mil sakti hain (Fundamental Principle of Counting).

Tasdeeq
\[\text{all seatings} = 10! = 3628800\]
\[\dfrac{725760}{3628800} = \dfrac{1}{5}\]
Kyun: Shart ke baghair 11 log gol table par \(10!\) tareeqon se beth sakte hain. P ke 10 doosre logon mein se sirf 2 us ke parosi hote hain, to Q ke P ke saath bethne ka hissa \(2/10 = 1/5\) hona chahiye. Hamara jawab theek 1/5 hai.
